terbaru.judul: PROMO: Preference-conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Robots
terbaru.pelajaran: We present PROMO (Preference-Conditioned Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning), a semantic multi-objective approach that makes this trade-off an explicit runtime input to a single locomotion policy.

terbaru.judul: Beyond Leaderboards: Tokenomics of Agentic Small Language Model Ensembles
terbaru.pelajaran: As large language models (LLMs) move from standalone assistants into agentic workflows, evaluation must extend beyond scalar leaderboard accuracy to account for operational reliability, cost, latency, and token efficiency.

terbaru.judul: Learning Multiple Timescales for Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: Existing approaches to offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) struggle with long-horizon tasks.

terbaru.judul: GrammarRL: Effective Grammar-Constrained Decoding via Reinforcement Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce GrammarRL, a label-free reinforcement learning method that adapts language models to grammar constraints without requiring annotated data.

terbaru.judul: Doing More with Less Tokens: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Coding Agents
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we study a more general paradigm without suffering from the limitation, i.e., training token-efficient coding agents with promising resolution performance, which is a highly-practical yet less-explored problem.

terbaru.judul: aRieL - Reinforcement Learning for the Ariel Space Telescope Scheduling
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce aRieL, a simulated observing environment coupled to a Set Transformer Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) agent that is trained to generate a scheduling policy.

terbaru.judul: Explore Broadly, Reason Sharply: Push Small Models toward the Frontier via Sampling
terbaru.pelajaran: To resolve this trade-off, we introduce \textbf{Parallel Power Tempering (PPT)}, instantiating power-sharpened LLM sampling via parallel tempering.

terbaru.judul: RL-PaO: Prediction as Action in Decision Making under Uncertainty
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce RL-PaO, a reinforcement learning framework that integrates system formulation, optimization, and decision execution into a single environment.

terbaru.judul: VLALight: A Vision-Language-Action Model for Traffic Signal Control
terbaru.pelajaran: We present VLALight, the first vision-language-action (VLA) model for end-to-end traffic signal control from multi-view roadside videos.

terbaru.judul: Quality Determines Direction, Length Shapes Magnitude: Length Control for Open-Ended Reinforcement Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: Reinforcement learning (RL) changes not only what language models say, but also how much they say, often increasing response length at the cost of token efficiency.
